checklist_100.item: Top Fun drone race locations won

missable_warning: There is exactly ONE missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude. Meditate at every spot before the final mission — some spots become unavailable after the story ends.

phases.goal: Finish the story, unlock the map, and clear the one missable trophy along the way.
phases.name: Story First
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

phases.goal: Sweep collectibles, activities and the crime trophies with the whole map open.
phases.name: Leonida Cleanup

phases.goal: Finish the stranger strands, hit 100% completion, and let the platinum pop.
phases.name: Platinum Push

steps.detail: Play the story in order. As meditation spots open, meditate at each one and tick it off — Positive Mental Attitude is the game's only missable trophy and some spots lock after the finale. Sample the early activities too: Gone Fishing, the Cal fishing challenge, one arcade game, and one of each activity type for Master of None.
steps.title: Play Chapters 1-2 and start the missable

steps.detail: Push through Chapters 3, 4 and 5. The chapter trophies, the named story missions (The Cartel Heist, VCIA Takedown, Headliners, Child's Play, Operation Savage Glory) and the final-mission gold all unlock along the way. Before the finale, double-check every meditation spot is done.
steps.title: Finish the story, Chapters 3-5

steps.detail: Work the stranger mission strands to their finales: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more. Each finale is its own bronze trophy, and the eighth completed strand unlocks the Strangers & Freaks silver. Follow the stranger markers as they appear on the map.
steps.title: Stranger strands: 8 finales

steps.detail: Sweep the map region by region: 3 full card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, and explore every region of Leonida. Do this sweep with the whole map open — it is far faster post-story, and the same routes cover the WAiNK, vehicle and exploration trophies at once.
steps.title: Collectibles sweep

steps.detail: Win 20 different races, win a Top Fun drone race at every location, earn gold in all shooting-range challenges, and complete 50 challenges. Add the 250 stunt jumps here too — a fast bike, region by region. These are the long grinds, so split them across sessions.
steps.title: Activities: races, range, challenges

steps.detail: Partner robberies (3 shops back-to-back, 4-star escape), the undetected jewelry store, 5 bank vaults, one armored truck, one illegal operation per gang, 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the Rhino, the showroom smash, and the Kelly County late-night event. Launder Marked Bills and spend $100,000 as you go.
steps.title: Crime spree with your partner

steps.detail: Buy all garage properties, register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, finish laundering $250,000 in Marked Bills, and watch the in-game completion stat climb to 100% for the A Long Road gold. The moment the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! — the platinum — pops with it.
steps.title: Money, garages and 100%

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
